verdict.rationale: Lorikeet ships Coach, a built-in AI assistant that users can talk to inside Lorikeet (as well as Slack, Claude and ChatGPT). Coach can implement improvements on the user's behalf or suggest fixes, and it turns quality-review findings into fixes for the AI agent. The MCP-server features let external assistants act on the account, but they are not an in-product assistant and only show tasks being delegated from outside. Missing for 10: documentation of the range of tasks Coach accepts beyond QA and agent improvements, details of the in-product delegation UX, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
